title: Hide Tags from Kit App Ui
description: Remove all tag-related UI from the Kit app in the sketchpad. Tags should never be visible, selectable, or interactable in the diagram view, table view, toolbar filter toggles, or toolbar create actions.
summary: Surgically removed all tag-related UI from the Kit app in the sketchpad. Tags are no longer visible, selectable, or interactable in the diagram view, table view, toolbar filter toggles, or toolbar create actions. 25+ edits across KitDiagramNodeKind, KIT_DIAGRAM_SHAPE_STRATEGY_REGISTRY, ArtifactKind, KitKindToggles, KitCreateActions, buildKitDiagramData, visibleGuids, table row building, node hover/selection handlers, useKitAppSelectAll, AppContent variables, handleRowClick, row icon rendering, artifactKinds constant, and test code. Internal data management (useKitTags, tag CRUD commands, selection state) preserved for backend/model use. All 105 tests pass, 0 regressions.
